biomarkers.name: Round cell component (%)
biomarkers.clinical_use: >5% round cells associates with worse prognosis and higher metastatic potential

biomarkers.name: NY-ESO-1
biomarkers.clinical_use: TCR-engineered T cells (letetresgene autoleucel, afami-cel — afamitresgene autoleucel) — approved for advanced synovial sarcoma and being tested in myxoid liposarcoma

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Uniform round to spindle cells in myxoid stroma with characteristic 'chicken-wire' delicate arborising capillary network; scattered lipoblasts
variants: round cell (>5% round cell component — higher grade)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Round cell content drives prognosis — pure myxoid is low-grade; >5% round cell content is high-grade

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: NY-ESO-1 expression makes it a target for TCR-engineered T cell therapy
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Delicate 'chicken-wire' capillary network and myxoid extracellular matrix are pathognomonic

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Mesenchymal precursors with adipocytic differentiation potential; distinct fusion-driven lineage from WD/DD LPS
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Distinctive round to spindle cells in myxoid stroma with delicate 'chicken-wire' capillary network; scattered lipoblasts confirm adipocytic lineage; round cell component (>5%) reflects less differentiated state
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: FUS-DDIT3 (t(12;16)) or EWSR1-DDIT3 (t(12;22)) fusion drives distinct disease from WD/DD LPS — DDIT3 (CHOP) is a transcription factor normally activated in adipocyte differentiation stress response; the fusion locks it in aberrant transcriptional programme; round cell component represents higher-grade/less-differentiated cellular state
